name: Anouk Van Brug - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on European Central Bank – annual report 2024
part_text:
The European Parliament gives its opinion on the European Central Bank's work in 2024. It says inflation has fallen but is not fully under control, and it asks the bank to keep interest rates from falling too fast. It also asks the bank to explain how it meets its wider goals, to keep cash available alongside a future digital euro, and to protect privacy. The report does not change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet; this is Parliament's opinion and set of requests to the bank.
- **Who it affects:** The European Central Bank, banks, and people in countries that use the euro.
- **What happens next:** The text goes to the Council, the Commission and the bank; the bank decides whether to act on it.
